cards.name: Polukranos Reborn // Polukranos, Engine of Ruin
The Walls of Ba Sing Se
Venat, Heart of Hydaelyn // Hydaelyn, the Mothercrystal

Darksteel Hydra.text: Upgraded: a manifest never has to be flipped, so the 0/0 flip doesn't matter, and The Notary Hobbits' colourless pays a big X. Indestructible, but power equals toughness, so it gains nothing from the enablers.

Eerie Ultimatum.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft
Eerie Ultimatum.text: returns lands too (landfall, F3); WWBBBGG is a hard 7

Crime // Punishment.group: Interaction — the -X/-X sweepers spare our high-toughness board
Crime // Punishment.text: Punishment is an X sweeper that our mana values dodge; Crime steals a creature from their graveyard. The tools count it as no role. Replaced Break Down the Door.

Perennation.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft

Call the Crash.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft

Ivorytusk Fortress.text: Untaps every creature with a counter on each opponent's turn; endure puts counters everywhere, so the team attacks and still blocks. Replaced Veteran Beastrider.

Betor, Kin to All.text: F7 — draws every turn from turn ~4, untaps at 20

Betor, Ancestor's Voice.text: 3/5 flying lifelink; each end step counters equal to life gained, and recursion up to the life you lost. Replaced Yathan Roadwatcher.

Yathan Roadwatcher.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft
Yathan Roadwatcher.text: Cut for Betor, Ancestor's Voice. MV≤3 recursion, only when cast.

Thalia and The Gitrog Monster.text: extra land (F3), opponents' creatures enter tapped, attack-draw

Felothar the Steadfast.text: global enabler + defenders attack + sac-draw by toughness

Revival of the Ancestors.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft
Revival of the Ancestors.text: trample finisher chapter matters for toughness damage

Kethis, the Hidden Hand.text: legendary count to be measured at draft

Severance Priest.text: F9 — hands the opponent an X/X

Felothar, Dawn of the Abzan.text: Sacrifices an endure Spirit or a Plant on entering and on every attack to put a counter on each creature. Replaced Kin-Tree Invocation.

Anafenza, the Foremost.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft
Anafenza, the Foremost.text: one-sided graveyard hate, counter on tapped creature

Abzan Ascendancy.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft
Abzan Ascendancy.text: counters on team, spirits on death

Abzan Monument.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft
Abzan Monument.text: basic to hand now, X/X (greatest toughness) later — 30/30 with Walls

Kin-Tree Invocation.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft
Kin-Tree Invocation.text: Cut for Felothar, Dawn of the Abzan. A 2-mana X/X (greatest toughness) is still a fine early play.

Nog, Ambitious Cadet.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft
Nog, Ambitious Cadet.text: 3/4 body, extra land drop + lands from graveyard (F3)

Ancient Lumberknot.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft
Ancient Lumberknot.text: Cut for Zopandrel. The deck is down to 7 toughness-damage enablers; this is the first to bring back if attacks stall.

Garruk, Apex Predator.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft
Garruk, Apex Predator.text: Cut for Selfless Glyphweaver. 7-mana removal plus 3/3 deathtouch tokens.

Hauntwoods Shrieker.text: F5 — {1}{G} flips anything; manifests on attack

Harrowing Swarm.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft
Harrowing Swarm.text: Cut for Claim the Kingdom. One manifest plus a {2} flip discount.

Break Down the Door.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft
Break Down the Door.text: Cut for Crime // Punishment. Instant artifact/enchantment exile or a manifest; return it if you face artifact decks.

Guardian of the Forgotten.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft
Guardian of the Forgotten.text: manifests top card when a modified creature dies (may be unflippable)

Beorn's Hospitality.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft

Druid Class.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft
Druid Class.text: Cut for Cursed Wombat. Extra land drop plus life per landfall.

Sharp-Eyed Rookie.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft
Sharp-Eyed Rookie.text: Cut for Arwen. Clues off every high-toughness creature; a fine return if card advantage runs thin.

Arwen, Weaver of Hope.text: With Captain America's Shield on her she's a 2/9, so every creature after her, each Hamza manifest included, enters with 9 extra counters. Replaced Sharp-Eyed Rookie.

Dormant Grove // Gnarled Grovestrider.text: Benched for The Notary Hobbits. Transforms on its first combat into team vigilance, which overlaps Ivorytusk Fortress untapping every creature with counters.

Bedrock Tortoise.text: T>P enabler + team hexproof on our turn

Flatman.text: 1/10 for 4; flip 4 → endure 10; don't switch him under an enabler

Mythweaver Poq.group: Landfall and extra land drops (every land is a Hamza manifest)
Mythweaver Poq.text: Conjures a duplicate of the first land each turn: an extra Hamza trigger, two with Elesh Norn. Replaced The Necrobloom.

Tapestry Warden.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft
Tapestry Warden.text: Cut for Basri Ket. A toughness-damage enabler for creatures with toughness above power; second in line behind Lumberknot (7 enablers left).

Ashaya, Soul of the Wild.text: F6 loop; also every creature counts as a land for Poq/Braulios

Braulios of Pheres Band.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft
Braulios of Pheres Band.text: Attack-draw plus a land onto the battlefield (another Hamza trigger); with Ashaya its size counts creatures too. Card flow the deck is short on.

Fecund Greenshell.text: T>P creature enters → land onto battlefield (F3) or a card; +2/+2 at 10 lands

Swampbenders.text: Underrated with Ashaya (creatures become lands, all lands become Swamps, its size counts both) and every land taps for black. Still 6 mana for one body.

Towering Titan.group: Walls and cheap high-toughness flips (Hamza endures X = toughness when one is turned face up)
Towering Titan.text: Cast, it enters with counters equal to every other creature's toughness (20–60 here); sacrificing a defender gives the team trample. If Hamza manifests it, leave it face down — a flip is 0/0. Replaced Amaranthine Wall.

Last March of the Ents.text: Draws equal to the greatest toughness, then puts creatures from hand onto the battlefield. The draw isn't optional, so with the Walls out it's 30 cards. Replaced Eladamri.

Bark of Doran.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft
Bark of Doran.text: Cheapest way back to 8 enablers: +0/+1 and toughness damage for {1} to equip. On Arwen it also adds 1 to every creature's entering counters.

Rasaad, Monk of Selûne.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft

Teyo, Aegis Adept.text: perpetual base power = toughness; defenders attack

Loxodon Lifechanter.text: Life becomes total toughness (30–50 here), then {5}{W}: +X/+X where X is life, a one-swing kill under an enabler. Replaced Icetill Explorer.

Ghalta the Immovable.group: Toughness enablers — each creature (or each with toughness > power) deals damage equal to its toughness
Ghalta the Immovable.text: Toughness-damage enabler that lets defenders attack; costs about 4 with a 5-toughness creature out (9 if flipped). Replaced Hakoda.

The Kingpin of Crime.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft
The Kingpin of Crime.text: Cut for Catapult Fodder. Its enabler costs 2 life per attack; Bark of Doran or Ghalta do the job more cheaply.

Blighted Nightmare.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft
Blighted Nightmare.text: repeatable reanimation capped by toughness; blight paid by walls (F10)

South Wind Avatar.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft

Elspeth Resplendent.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft
Elspeth Resplendent.text: counters + keyword, dig MV≤3 with shield

Captain America's Shield.text: +0/+8 = +8 damage under an enabler; taps a blocker

Choking Miasma.group: Interaction — the -X/-X sweepers spare our high-toughness board
Choking Miasma.text: −2/−2 sweep our walls shrug off. Flip the face-down 2/2s you want to keep first; each flip is a Hamza endure. Replaced Infernal Grasp.

Mythos of Nethroi.text: instant destroy any nonland permanent (GW spent)

Chevill, Bane of Monsters.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft

Cursed Wombat.text: Every time counters land on a permanent (each endure, Arwen, Basri) it gets one more. Replaced Druid Class.

Vraska Joins Up.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft
Vraska Joins Up.text: Upgraded: draws whenever a legendary creature connects, and the deck runs 23 legendary nonland cards; the deathtouch counters make every wall lethal on the block.

Stalwart Successor.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft

Jenova, Ancient Calamity.text: RE-GRADED (owner): 1/5 gap 4 = +4/+4 under Doran; endure counters and Teyo's base-power rebase raise her power, so the combat counters scale (F11)

Kagha, Shadow Archdruid.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft
Kagha, Shadow Archdruid.text: Cut for Impervious Greatwurm. Card flow from milled cards.

Professor Dellian Fel.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft

The Last Ronin.text: kills our walls too unless Walls of Ba Sing Se is out

Madame Null, Power Broker.text: F11 — face-down 2/2s enter at power 2: pay 2 life for 2 counters per manifest

Jadzia Dax, Living Legacy.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft

Ferrafor, Young Yew.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft
Ferrafor, Young Yew.text: Doubles every counter on one creature each turn (Arwen- and endure-loaded creatures); {6}{G} is easy with The Notary Hobbits.

The Walls of Ba Sing Se.text: 0/30; other permanents you control are indestructible. Alone it clears Betor, Kin to All's 40 total toughness; flipped from a manifest by Hauntwoods Shrieker it endures 30.

Multiply by Zero.group: Interaction — the -X/-X sweepers spare our high-toughness board
Multiply by Zero.text: 2-mana instant: base 0/0 kills most creatures (not ones with counters). The tools count it as no role. Replaced Languish.

Karametra, God of Harvests.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft
Karametra, God of Harvests.text: each creature cast fetches a land onto the battlefield (F3)

Restoration Magic.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft
Restoration Magic.text: Cut for Smuggler's Surprise, whose {1} mode does the same protection with more options.

Basri Ket.text: +1 puts a counter and indestructible on a creature each turn; −2 makes attacking 1/1s; the emblem counters the whole team each combat. Replaced Tapestry Warden (owner's pick).

Earthshape.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft
Earthshape.text: Cut for Strength of Will. One turn of protection for every power-≤3 creature.

Akroma's Will.text: double strike doubles toughness damage; both modes with Hamza out

Hakoda, Selfless Commander.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft
Hakoda, Selfless Commander.text: Cut for Ghalta. One-shot +0/+5 and indestructible for the team; the first protection piece to bring back.

Oketra the True.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft

Moogles' Valor.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft

Eagle of Deliverance.text: Indestructible counter on another creature, and a draw because nearly everything here has power 2 or less. Replaced Whisperwood Elemental.

Angelic Guardian.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft

Avacyn, Angel of Hope.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft

Smuggler's Surprise.text: {4}{G} puts two creatures from hand onto the battlefield; they ENTER, so Towering Titan (now in the deck) gets its counters and the Walls skip 8 mana. {1} mode gives hexproof and indestructible. Replaced Restoration Magic.

Claim the Kingdom.group: Landfall and extra land drops (every land is a Hamza manifest)
Claim the Kingdom.text: A counter on every land drop (each already a Hamza trigger); the fourth gives an indestructible counter. Replaced Harrowing Swarm.

Origin of Metalbending.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft

Song of Freyalise.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft
Song of Freyalise.text: mana from face-downs for two turns

Strength of Will.text: Indestructible, and damage dealt to it becomes +1/+1 counters — cast it on a blocking wall. Replaced Earthshape.

Inspiring Call.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft
Inspiring Call.text: Card advantage is now the thinnest axis (8). With endure, Arwen, Basri, Claim the Kingdom and Cursed Wombat, most of the board carries counters, so this often draws 5+ and makes them indestructible.

Toski, Bearer of Secrets.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft
Toski, Bearer of Secrets.text: Upgraded: a draw for each creature that connects, and Delney plus toughness damage connect a lot. Card advantage is the thin axis. It must attack each combat.

Majestic Myriarch.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft

Zopandrel, Hunger Dominus.text: Doubles every creature's power AND toughness at each combat, on both players' turns — double damage on offence, double walls on defence. Replaced Ancient Lumberknot.

Rok-Tahk, Budding Scientist.text: every face-down taps for GG → pays flips (F5)

Impervious Greatwurm.text: 16/16 indestructible with convoke: face-down 2/2s and Hobbit tokens pay most of it. Creatures tapped for it can't block that turn. Replaced Kagha.

Amaranthine Wall.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft
Amaranthine Wall.text: Cut for Towering Titan. A colourless 0/6 that flips for 4 → endure 6.

Plaza of Heroes.group: Lands — fetches count twice for landfall; Threats Around Every Corner wants basics
Plaza of Heroes.text: Any colour for 23 legendary spells (Felothar, Doran, Thalia and The Gitrog Monster…) and the deck's only hexproof/indestructible for Hamza. Replaced 1 Forest.

Eladamri, Korvecdal.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft
Eladamri, Korvecdal.text: Cut for Last March. Casting creatures from the top is good, but GG on turn 3 is 66% here.

Veteran Beastrider.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft
Veteran Beastrider.text: Cut for Ivorytusk Fortress, which does the same attack-and-block job on a bigger body.

Enduring Innocence.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft
Enduring Innocence.text: Draws once a turn when a power-2 creature enters, which Hamza supplies every land drop. A strong return candidate while card advantage sits at 8.

Destined Confrontation.text: one-sided wrath for a power-0 board (F2)

Slumbering Walker.text: power≤2 recursion each end step, fuelled by endure counters; flips as 4/7 (F4)

Smile at Death.text: two power≤2 creatures back every upkeep (F2)

Body Launderer.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft

Ruthless Technomancer.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft
Ruthless Technomancer.text: Downgraded: X=1 returns a 0-power wall, but the deck's only artifacts are the Shield, Crystal Barricade and The Walls, which are the things you'd want to keep.

Golden-Tail Trainer.text: F11 — endure counters make every creature 'modified'; scales only once its own power grows

Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines.text: a land entering → Hamza's landfall triggers TWICE (also Necrobloom, Threats, both loops); 4/7, flips 5 → 7

Huatli, the Sun's Heart.text: 3-mana global toughness-damage enabler on a planeswalker (not a seek target)

Essence of Antiquity.text: 1/10; disguise flip {2}{W} → endure 10 + team hexproof + untap

Hooded Hydra.text: morph/manifest flip adds 5 counters THEN endures 5; dies into snakes

Tree of Perdition.text: 0/13 for 4 — flip 4 → endure 13; life-swap with its toughness (spice)

The Necrobloom.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft
The Necrobloom.text: Cut for Mythweaver Poq. A Plant per land, two with Elesh Norn; good with Felothar, Dawn of the Abzan as sacrifice fodder.

Toxic Deluge.text: pay X, −X/−X: at X=4 our 5+ toughness board survives (one-sided)

Languish.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft
Languish.text: Cut for Multiply by Zero. −4/−4 our walls survive, but BB and it kills the face-down 2/2s.

Find // Finality.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft

The Meathook Massacre.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft

Infernal Grasp.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft
Infernal Grasp.text: Cut 2026-11-24 for Choking Miasma (owner's pick). Still a clean 2-mana kill if spot removal runs short.

Mortify.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft

Putrefy.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft

Mentor of the Meek.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft
Mentor of the Meek.text: Card advantage is the thinnest axis (8). Every face-down 2/2 Hamza manifests has power 2, and Elesh Norn doubles the trigger; The Notary Hobbits' colourless pays the {1}s. The strongest draw card on the bench.

Trail of Mystery.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft
Trail of Mystery.text: Cut for Dormant Grove, which has since gone to the bench too. Basics to hand per face-down and +2/+2 on every flip; face-down support worth returning.

Whisperwood Elemental.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft
Whisperwood Elemental.text: Cut for Eagle of Deliverance. A manifest every end step — the face-down engine piece most worth returning.

Verdant Dread.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft

Valgavoth's Onslaught.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft
Valgavoth's Onslaught.text: X manifests with X counters each; The Notary Hobbits' colourless pays the {X}{X}, and Elesh Norn doubles the landfall that follows Threats fetches.

Sleuth Instructor.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft

Pine Walker.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft
Pine Walker.text: untaps each creature turned face up

Reaping Willow.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft
Reaping Willow.text: flips as 3/6 (no −1/−1); endure counters fuel its MV≤3 recursion

Catapult Fodder // Catapult Captain.group: Walls and cheap high-toughness flips (Hamza endures X = toughness when one is turned face up)
Catapult Fodder // Catapult Captain.text: A 1/5 for 3 that transforms off three creatures with toughness above power, then sacrifices for life loss equal to toughness: 30 from the Walls. Replaced The Kingpin of Crime.

Icetill Explorer.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft
Icetill Explorer.text: Cut for Loxodon Lifechanter. Extra land drop plus lands from the graveyard; return it if landfall feels thin.

Oracle of Mul Daya.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft

The Gitrog Monster.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft

Walking Bulwark.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft

Belligerent Brontodon.group: Bench — real, not in the first draft
Belligerent Brontodon.text: A global toughness-damage enabler at 7; The Notary Hobbits pays most of it. Worth a look if enablers feel thin and the curve allows.

Selfless Glyphweaver // Deadly Vanity.group: Interaction — the -X/-X sweepers spare our high-toughness board
Selfless Glyphweaver // Deadly Vanity.text: Front: exile it for team indestructible. Back: an 8-mana wipe that keeps your best creature. Replaced Garruk, Apex Predator.

Wildgrove Summoner.text: turns Forests into creature cards → Hamza's seek can find a land it cannot flip (no mana cost)

The Notary Hobbits.group: Landfall and extra land drops (every land is a Hamza manifest)
The Notary Hobbits.text: Owned. Two token copies; each Halfling taps for one per Halfling, so about 9 colourless from the next turn, 25 with Elesh Norn. Pays The Walls' 8-mana flip, Last March, Titan and Lifechanter's pump. Flipped from a manifest it makes no tokens. Replaced Dormant Grove.

Venat, Heart of Hydaelyn // Hydaelyn, th.text: Owned. Draws once a turn when you cast a legendary spell (23 in the deck). {7},T: exile a nonland permanent (the Hobbits pay it), then it transforms: each combat a counter and indestructible on another creature, plus a draw if that creature is legendary. Card advantage, interaction and protection in one. WW on turn 3 is about 63%.

Tireless Tracker.text: A Clue on every land drop, two with Elesh Norn, and it grows when you crack them. Fixes the thinnest axis (card advantage 8) off the deck's own engine; the Hobbits' colourless cracks Clues.

Wall of Omens.text: 0/4 defender that draws on entering. Flips for 2 → endure 4; Smile at Death and Slumbering Walker return power ≤2 creatures, so it re-draws every time.

Wall of Blossoms.text: Green Wall of Omens: 0/4, draws on entering, flips for 2 → endure 4, and the power-capped recursion re-buys the draw.

Carven Caryatid.text: 2/5 defender that draws on entering; flips for 3 → endure 5. Power 2, so Smile at Death returns it.

Sylvan Caryatid.text: 0/3 hexproof defender that taps for any colour: fixing for the double-pip cards (Basri, Choking Miasma, Hauntwoods) plus a cheap flip (2 → endure 3).

Welcoming Vampire.text: Draws once a turn when a power-2-or-less creature enters, which every Hamza manifest is. A 2/3 flier. Card advantage tied to the engine.

Sumala Sentry.text: 1/3 for GW: whenever a face-down creature is turned face up, a counter on it and on the Sentry (two each with Cursed Wombat). Stacks on Hamza's endure.

Greenbelt Radical.text: Disguise: cast face down for 3, flip for {5}{G}{G} (the Hobbits help) → a counter on every creature and team trample, which toughness damage badly wants; Hamza also endures it 4.

Vigorbloom Charm.text: Owned. 2-mana instant: hexproof and indestructible on a permanent, or draw and gain 3, or a counter then a fight. Protection or card advantage as needed.

Sword of Forge and Frontier.text: On a toughness attacker that connects (Delney makes that easy): play the top two cards and an extra land, which is another Hamza trigger. +2/+2 and protection from red and green.

Inspiring Commander.text: Life and a draw for every power-≤2 creature that enters, with no once-a-turn limit, so each manifest draws (two with Elesh Norn). 6 mana for a 1/4.

Symmetry Matrix.text: Spice: every face-down 2/2 and every endure Spirit token has power equal to toughness, so each one entering is a {1} draw; the Hobbits pay for it.

Hornet Nest.text: Spice: blocks and makes deathtouch fliers equal to the damage taken. Only a 0/2, so it's a poor flip and dies to our own sweepers.
